# Fixtures

Item of note: the files `cms-signed-digested.pem`, `cms-signed-digested.der`,
`pkcs7-signed-digested.pem` and `pkcs7-signed-digested.der` all have invalid
signatures since the structures were hand edited to highlight the one
incompatibility between CMS and PKCS#7.

## Synthetic PKCS#12 evidence samples

`analysis/sample_builder.py` generates two fully-decrypted PKCS#12 containers
for the SafeBag evidence tests:

- `name-collision.p12` - a key and two certificates share a friendlyName; only
  one certificate matches the key's public key material
- `missing-local-key-id.p12` - a matching key/certificate pair without any
  `localKeyId` attributes

They use toy RSA values for test speed and contain no real secrets.

The committed copies live in `tests/fixtures/pkcs12-evidence/`. They are
regenerated by `python -m analysis.generate_samples <dir>`.
